_about: Phase 7A section 6 probes, written and committed before any was run: the brief's ten expressions of 'Nora Vance began working for Halden in March 2025', which do not all assert the same thing, plus sampled benchmark turns referenced by id only (their text is read from .data/ at run time and never written). 'expect' states what a correct extractor within the candidate contract should produce from the message (with its context): type, roles, time kinds, attribution mode, commitment, relations; null where nothing should be extracted. Each probe runs on Path A (RulesV2.extract directly) and Path B (wrapped as a LoCoMo conversation and as a LongMemEval session, through the dataset adapters and the Phase 6D extraction and store pathway).
speaker: Ivo Marsh

probes.text: Nora Vance joined Halden in March 2025.
Nora started working for Halden in March 2025.
Nora has worked at Halden since March 2025.
probes.note: held since March, still holds; not a stated start

probes.text: Since March 2025, Nora has been with Halden.
Nora's been at Halden since March.
probes.note: month without a year: the most recent past March
pronoun subject and 'them' with no antecedent: nothing can be attributed to anyone

probes.text: I started working there last March.
probes.note: first person is the speaker, but 'there' has no antecedent: no employer

probes.text: Nora told me she joined Halden in March.
probes.note: 'she' resolves to Nora within the sentence; reported speech

probes.text: Apparently Nora started at Halden in March.
Correction: Nora joined Halden in April, not March.

benchmark_turns.why: the one representative in-domain assertion (title at a named company, for about six weeks)
people in roles at named organisations, in a table
a role at an unnamed institution
employment ended, employer unnamed; started own business
